Sam and Fearne debate people-pleaser approaches to leaving parties and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from his content creation work. Sam also reveals why he was willing to pay to appear on I'm A Celebrity.

programme.title: Sam Claflin Asks What Is Body Dysmorphia?
programme.desc: Actor Sam Claflin discusses his lifelong struggle with body dysmorphia and body image with Fearne Cotton. Sam explains what having body dysmorphia means to him and how it affects everything from the food he eats to his willingness to watch his own films back. Fearne and Sam discuss being chronic people pleasers and how they're working to stop putting everyone else's comfort before their own. Sam reflects on how he was brought up to think about masculinity and what he's doing to ensure his own son grows up with gentler male role models. They also reminisce about the early days of MSN and webcam chatrooms.

programme.title: Chris Appleton: From Being Bullied to Styling the Kardashians
programme.desc: Celebrity hair stylist Chris Appleton chats with Fearne about why we change our hair when we want to start over. Chris explains that everyone from the Kardashians to cancer patients have opened up to him about their insecurities, and he's seen the profound impact that looking more like yourself on the outside can have on how you feel about yourself on the inside. He's fascinated by the self-limiting beliefs people have about who they are. Chris has dealt with a lot of his own shame and fears too. He was bullied at school, struggled to acknowledge his sexuality, and had huge imposter syndrome when he first arrived in Hollywood. He also gives Fearne a consultation about going bolder with her hair. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicidal ideation.

programme.title: Jimmy Carr on Feminism, Parenting, and Success
programme.desc: Comedian Jimmy Carr discusses defining success without comparing yourself to others, the importance of hard work, and why he doesn't fear cancel culture. He explains his views on feminism and motherhood, why he refuses to use the term "babysitting" for parenting his own children, and how his anxieties fuel his comedy.

programme.title: Nafessa Williams On Racism, Sexism, and Rivals
programme.desc: Rivals actress Nafessa Williams discusses playing the only black woman in a white man's world in 1980s Britain, and how she sees her acting as her contribution to activism and representation. She explores what it means to be on a TV show with intimate scenes, the journey from law to acting, manifestation and taking action, faith and optimism, and the importance of rest alongside ambition.

programme.title: Carol Vorderman Talks Politics, Education, and Parenting
programme.desc: Broadcaster Carol Vorderman discusses her early life, from her family running away with the circus and living out of a car, to being one of the first girls to read engineering at Cambridge University. She reveals who wrote her first application to Countdown and explains why everything about our lives is political, from the pressure put on kids and parents by schools to women's bodily autonomy.

programme.title: Poorna Bell On How To Put Yourself First
programme.desc: Award-winning journalist and author Poorna Bell joins Fearne to talk about ageing, ambition, marriage, motherhood, grief and the quiet rage that can build when women feel invisible. From challenging the narrative that women "disappear" in midlife, to questioning the myth of "having it all", this conversation is about reclaiming agency, on your own terms.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

The bullet grazes the right side of Kelly's head. Bosley knocks Danworth out and Kelly is rushed to the hospital in a very serious condition. While Bosley, Kris and Julie are keeping vigil at the hospital, they sadly reminisce about Kelly. programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

But with Mark breathing down his neck and micromanaging his methods, Will's rebellious nature is stirred up. Meanwhile, Josh is doing some heavy metal work on another 1970 'Cuda that was once thought to be a 440 6 barrel, automatic.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The team takes on the biggest engine challenge of their lives! A numbers matching 383 for a 1971 'Cuda, that has multiple, massive, freeze cracks in the block. Mark puts a local shop to the test, as they attempt to save an engine, that at one time, would not be savable. But with no promises and mounting expenses, will this massive engine gamble pay off? Meanwhile in the metal shop, the ghouls tackle another tribute wing car, a Daytona.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When the local junkyard closes its doors, Mark and Dougie have to rescue an old friend from the earliest days of Graveyard Carz. At the shop, Will continues to push the 1970 AAR 'Cuda through paint and into assembly, and the team continues work on a very original, one owner, 1970 Super Bee, 383, air conditioning car, in Plum Crazy! With most of the car rusted out, this massive reconstruction may be thwarted by a scarcity of parts.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When Tony D'Agostino makes another trip to the west coast, Mark Worman takes the opportunity to revisit the Brothers Car Collection in Salem, Oregon to do a deep dive on a 1971 Hemi 'Cuda that shares history with the Sandwich Man himself. This one-of-a-kind Mopar was purchased by Zachary Taylor Reynolds, grandson of tobacco tycoon R.J. Reynolds, and is considered to be the highest optioned, lowest mile, most original 1971 Hemi 'Cuda in existence.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The Vanishing Point Challenger has not disappeared from view. After years of gathering rust in the Graveyard, this 1970 Alpine White Challenger R/T tribute car has been cleaned up, and has received most of its sheet metal. It's time to wrap up metal with the tail end of the car. Meanwhile, Will experiences deja vu as he paints another '69 Roadrunner in A4 Silver, nearly identical in color to the recent Graveyard Dreamz car for Don Jones, Jr.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Tune in to the season finale of Graveyard Carz and find out what made this season one for the record books! On this special episode, Mark and the Ghoulz count and catalog every significant restoration, from the very first 1970 Road Runner in season 1 to the infamous 1971 Phoenix 'Cuda in season 16. The restorations of the past will be held up against the new restorations in this last particularly prolific season.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Finally, an episode of GYC that is all about A Bodies! The rarely seen Mopar A Body is revealed, not once but twice! Two A Body beasts that coincidently arrived around the same time also happen to be getting done at the same time. Mark and Will duke it out over their favorite A bodies: the 1969, A57, 383 4-speed, 'Cuda in B5 Blue for Mark and the overly optioned, one of a kind, 1971, Mr. Norm's, 340 six-pack, Demon, in FE5 Rallye Red for Will.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Graveyard Carz is about to unveil its seventh 2nd generation Charger. This is another Graveyard Dreamz build - the owner created this classic from the ground up with custom choices in an OEM style build! This Hemi Charger features things that just weren't possible from the factory in 1969, like air conditioning with a Hemi! But on top of that, this '69 Charger has leather, 6-way seats, beautiful deep black paint, and a camshaft that goes thump in the night!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's a busy day at Lemon's salon, a charming place that is more than just a hair salon it's one of favorite places for Strawberry and her friends to relax and socialize. All the girls are getting their hair done for the gala grand opening of Mr. Longface's new lawn-bowling and croquet club. They're spirited and laughing and chatting and having a great time, as Lemon runs from one of her friends to the next, doing hair and nails, serving tea and cookies.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry ordered some Zippy Gro daisy seeds and planted them in her garden. She is surprised that they've sprouted in less than a day despite their descriptive moniker. Strawberry comes by to admire them and Blueberry is reminded that the new cookbook Strawberry ordered has arrived. Strawberry is excited to try out the new corn muffin recipe, as its level of difficulty will be a challenge for her. Strawberry follows the muffin recipe, mixes the ingredients, and double checks it.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programme.desc: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While rehearsing a song alone in her cafe, Strawberry is interrupted by the arrival of Jadeybug. The poor ladybug is stressed out because her twin cousins, Kadiebug and Sadiebug, left her a message that they are coming to visit for a whole week. Jadey is unable to host them because she's having her guest room repainted.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He ends up getting a package of special berry seeds he ordered, not the vacation magazine Orange thought he came for. He explains how the seeds were a better purchase because of all the benefits to the Berryworks but now he can no longer afford a vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. She forgets, however, to check the sign-up sheet at the Café and schedules it for the same night as Blueberry is scheduled to read to the baby Berrykins. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programme.desc: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programme.desc: Blueberry has become obsessed with the mystery book detective heroine, Patti Persimmon. She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

programme.title: Snakebit
programme.desc: Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe – The Fangpyres – to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered, but are called to duty when the Fangpyres attack the village where Jay's family lives.

programme.title: Never Trust A Snake
programme.desc: After the Fangpyres join forces with the Hypnobrai, Lloyd awakens Pythor – the last remaining snake of the Anacondrai tribe. Pythor lures Lloyd under his spell and steals a map from him that will show him where the remaining two snakes tribes dwell and Uncle Sensei saves Lloyd from doom.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.desc: Today you will hear a story which you haven't heard before…about one boy who was transferred to another school! programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories

programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear hates to say goodbye to Masha and can't stand being apart. Meanwhile, other forest dwellers are chilling in the yard not knowing that this fragile paradise is on the verge of collapse as the Bear receives a long-awaited phone call from Masha…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha enthusiastically plays with her "dolls", but Rosie wants to be independent. She trades places with wolves and now they are under Masha's care. Rosie enjoys adult life, but everything is not that simple ...

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear decides to suit a big laundry in his yard, but yet he has no idea that soon he would have to pull Masha from a puddle and a jar of jam. But it's not all- now the Bear has to sew new dresses eve-ry time when Masha will get wet or dirty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: A funny interpretation of an old fable about a boy who called for help and shouted “Wolves!”. The Bear wants to watch a soccer game but first he needs to get rid of the girl. programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

programme.desc: When Tom's boxing career abruptly ends, he's offered a job as a door man at a run down night club, where he meets Paul, a volatile man with a history of violence. Soon it is unclear whether Tom has taken a step on the road to redemption, or finally hit the self-destruct button. Paul takes Tom under his wing to teach him the ropes, but he is soon at deadly odds with violent gangsters from the area.

Unbeknownst to her, Chelsea has now been exposed to a watcher who becomes obsessed and will stop at nothing to have her to himself.

programme.title: Blade of Storm
programme.desc: Five years ago, the town's demon gang, the largest gang in the rivers and lakes, made the court jealous because of their power. The leader, Long Xiaotian, in order to keep the rivers and lakes stable and the world was peaceful, announced the dissolution of the town's demon gang. It disappeared in the arena. Five years later, Long Xiaotian, who had already lived in seclusion, was arrested by his wife and was forced to leave the mountain to assassinate Li Shimin. programme.title: Till Death Do Us Part

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Flash Eater
programme.desc: When an unpredictable germ terrifies Texas in 1998, the CDC and health officials alert all neighboring states and territories to be on the lookout for streptococcus outbreak, the same bacteria that causes strep throat. This new strain, however, will kill 33 people, causing flesh-eating viruses, introducing deadly toxins into the blood and introducing pneumonia. Before the bacteria is contained, physicians from the United States and Canada will have to work together to fight the deadly strain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains- It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence. But what happens when the charred remains are found, unrecognizable, seemingly impossible to identify? Dr. John Verano and Dr. Doug Owsley of the Smithsonian have faced these challenges, identifying the burned remains of two American journalists found in Guatemala seven years after their reported disappearance. It seems as though fire can unveil lies, as well as conceal truths.

programme.title: CRIME FILES
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. It Tells The Compelling Stories Of Ordinary Lives Disrupted By Crime, With Relatable Characters Representing The World Around Us. The Show'S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED

programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...

programme.desc: Rabbit Hole è un adattamento dell'omonima pièce teatrale di David Lindsay-Abaire, vincitrice del Premio Pulitzer nel 2007. La storia ruota intorno a Becca (Nicole Kidman) ed Howie (Aaron Eckhart) una coppia newyorkese che ha perso il figlio di 4 anni in un incidente stradale. Le cose si complicano ulteriormente quando Becca si mette sulle tracce del giovane ragazzo che ha provocato l'incidente…La regia è firmata da John Cameron Mitchell autore del controverso “Shortbus” mentre della sceneggiatura si è occupato lo stesso Lindsay-Abaire. Nel cast figurano anche Tammy Blanchard, Dianne Wiest e Sandra Oh.

programme.title: Il segreto di una famiglia
programme.desc: Eugenia torna a La Quietud, la tenuta di famiglia vicino a Buenos Aires, dopo un ictus che ha colpito suo padre. Si ritrova con sua madre e sorella, costrette a confrontarsi con traumi emotivi e segreti legati al passato durante la dittatura militare, dove le vecchie gelosie riaffiorano.

programme.title: Critical Thinking
programme.desc: Basato su una storia vera del 1998, cinque adolescenti latini e neri provenienti dal ghetto più difficile di Miami lottano per entrare nel campionato nazionale di scacchi sotto la guida del loro insegnante anticonvenzionale ma ispiratore.

programme.title: Caccia all'uomo
programme.desc: Francia, 1944: Pierre Brossard - uno dei pochi ufficiali che fa parte della Milizia, un gruppo parapoliziesco controllato dal governo di Vichy - si rende responsabile dell'uccisione di sette membri ebrei della Resistenza. Dopo la liberazione, Brossard va sotto processo ed è condannato per i suoi crimini, ma sfugge alla cattura e anni dopo viene graziato. 1992: la vita di Brossard viene sconvolta da un'aggressione e dal fatto che una nuova legge permetterà di riportare davanti alla giustizia i criminali di guerra che non hanno scontato le loro condanne.

programme.title: Love shooting
programme.desc: Charlie è un produttore cinematografico che si lascia convincere a realizzare un film su Benjamin Disraeli, a patto che il protagonista sia un attore di grande fama che però verrà rapito, costringendo Charlie ad escogitare una soluzione creativa.

programme.title: Souvenir d'italie
programme.desc: La storia di tre turiste straniere: l'inglese Margaret, la francese Josette e la tedesca Hilde che passano la frontiera con l'Italia per visitare il nostro Paese ma un incidente alla loro macchina le costringerà ad arrangiarsi con mezzi di fortuna.

programme.title: Alex & Emma
programme.desc: Alex è uno scrittore pieno di debiti. Deve scrivere un romanzo entro un mese per avere il denaro con cui saldarli. Contatta la stenografa Emma per aiutarlo nell'impresa. Tra i due si instaura un rapporto che va oltre quello professionale.

programme.title: Un Piccolo Grande Eroe
programme.desc: La storia di Alan, adolescente malato di poliomelite che desidera cavalcare e ha come mito personale il west e i cowboy. Dai racconti dell'australiano Allan Marshall, un film sulla giovinezza e su quanti ancora ne custodiscono in cuore il segreto.

programme.title: La Rosa Velenosa
programme.desc: Carson Phillips, investigatore privato, viene coinvolto dalla sua ex-moglie in una indagine relativa all'uccisione del fidanzato della figlia. L'indagine prenderà una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: L'Uomo Che Sapeva Troppo Poco
programme.desc: Bill Murray è un americano imbranato che, mentre è in vacanza a Londra in visita al fratello, partecipa a un programma di 'virtual reality'. Quando crede che un vero tentativo di assassinio faccia parte del gioco, si trova per sbaglio immischiato in un caso di scambio d'identità e omicidio.

programme.title: 10th& Wolf
programme.desc: Un ex delinquente di strada torna a casa a Filadelfia dopo un periodo nell'esercito. Tornato in patria, si ritrova ancora una volta invischiato con il boss della mafia che è stato determinante nel suo diventare un soldato.

programme.title: Regression
programme.desc: Bruce Kenner è il detective più in gamba del suo dipartimento, una stazione di polizia di provincia, nel Minnesota, dove tutti conoscono tutti, dalla nascita o quasi. È il 1990 e una ragazzina di nome Angela ha accusato il padre, John Gray, di gravi abusi.

programme.title: Halloween The Beginning
programme.desc: Il feroce assassino Michael Meyers viene rilasciato dall'istituto psichiatrico in cui è stato rinchiuso per 17 anni e si scatena alla ricerca della sorella minore. Questo significa solo una cosa: nessuno è al sicuro!

programme.title: La città verrà distrutta all'alba
programme.desc: Immaginate di vivere in una piccola città dove tutto è sicuro e felice... finché improvvisamente non lo è più. In un terrificante racconto del "Sogno Americano" andato terribilmente storto, quattro abitanti di Ogden Marsh, IA, si ritrovano intrappolati nella loro città natale.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: Tre amici trovano milioni di dollari nascosti nel bosco, ma presto scoprono che appartengono a un criminale pericoloso. L'avidità e la paura trasformano il loro legame in un conflitto mortale, mentre cercano di sopravvivere alla furia del legittimo proprietario.

programme.title: Broken
programme.desc: Una giovane donna fugge dal suo passato e fugge in Inghilterra in cerca di una nuova vita. Accetta un lavoro per prendersi cura di un tetraplegico, ma il peso del lavoro agita il suo passato. Sembra che i limiti della cura non siano sempre così chiari come dovrebbero essere

programme.title: Come in un film di Natale
programme.desc: Due sorelle si risvegliano misteriosamente all'interno di un perfetto film natalizio e devono capire come vivere e amare secondo le regole di quel mondo da favola.

programme.title: Kid Santa
programme.desc: Babbo Natale si risveglia misteriosamente nel corpo di un bambino e, con l'aiuto della famiglia, cerca di tornare adulto e fermare chi vuole sabotare il Natale.

programme.title: Il magico mondo di Billie
programme.desc: Billie, una ragazza brillante, viene coinvolta in un'avventura fantastica dopo essere stata avvicinata da due misteriosi personaggi che promettono di esaudire ogni suo desiderio.

programme.title: Una babysitter per Natale
programme.desc: Un'organizzatrice di eventi assume una babysitter per la nipote e resta sorpresa quando si presenta un uomo che potrebbe essere perfetto non solo per il lavoro, ma anche per lei.

programme.title: Uno chalet per due
programme.desc: Durante una vacanza in chalet con la madre e la figlia, una donna incontra uno scrittore che detesta il Natale e scopre che la convivenza forzata può cambiare entrambi.

programme.title: The Nature of Romance
programme.desc: Una scrittrice di viaggi impegnata va a fare del campeggio di lusso in un parco naturale con la sua migliore amica e finisce per innamorarsi di una delle guardie del parco.

programme.title: Love on the Road
programme.desc: Abby, la conduttrice di un programma tv di ristrutturazione di ristoranti, riceve il nuovo incarico di trasformare una tavola calda di una piccola città in un posto ricercato. Mentre Abby e il proprietario della tavola calda, Tom, trascorrono tempo insieme, Abby scopre il significato della parola amore.

programme.title: Amore in ascolto
programme.desc: Peyton, produttrice di podcast, è costretta a trasformare Alex nella prossima star e creare lo show perfetto per salvare entrambe le loro carriere. Lo show consiste nel trovare il vero amore di Peyton. Ma mentre procedono, sono proprio loro due a trovare l'amore.

programme.title: Tre dolci parole
programme.desc: Tamara torna al meleto di famiglia sperando di prendersi una pausa dalla vita. Inizia a innamorarsi del suo migliore amico d'infanzia, Will, ora responsabile della fattoria, e insieme fanno di tutto per mantenere vivo il frutteto.

programme.title: L'amore non ha prezzo
programme.desc: Dopo aver scoperto che uno degli oggetti nel suo negozio di seconda mano è una teiera antica del valore di $80K, Rose si ritrova nel mirino di un ambizioso broker di antiquariato. Lui è determinato, ma lei si rifiuta di vendere finché non riesce a trovare il proprietario originale.

programme.title: I cavalieri del Nord Ovest
programme.desc: Il capitano Nathan Brittles, ad un passo dalla pensione, prende il comando di un'ultima missione con il compito di fermare un imminente grosso attacco indiano. La sua missione è messa in pericolo dalla presenza, fra le sue truppe, di alcune donne che devono essere evacuate.

programme.title: Woman wanted
programme.desc: Emma viene assunta come governante da Richard, un vedovo solitario, e suo figlio Wendell, un ragazzo tormentato dal lutto. La sua presenza porta luce nella casa, ma accende anche una rivalità inaspettata: quando sia il padre che il figlio si innamorano di lei, le tensioni esplodono.

programme.title: The House of the Spirits
programme.desc: Basato sul romanzo best-seller di Isabel Allende, La casa degli spiriti è un' indimenticabile storia romantica che attraversa le vicende di tre generazioni della famiglia Trueba.

programme.title: Women Talking
programme.desc: "Women Talking - Il diritto di scegliere" segue un gruppo di donne di un'isolata comunità religiosa mentre cercano di capire come costruire un mondo migliore per sé e i propri figli. Resta e combatti, o scappa. Non resteranno ferme a guardare.

programme.title: Ingannevole è il cuore piu di ogni cosa
programme.desc: Jeremiah, sette anni, è stato rimosso dalla sua famiglia adottiva e si ritrova immerso in una vita difficile in viaggio con sua madre, Sarah.

programme.title: The Secret Reunion
programme.desc: Un agente segreto nordcoreano e un agente sudcoreano un tempo rivali e ormai in congedo, si ritrovano a dover lavorare gomito a gomito in un'agenzia investigativa.

programme.title: Semper Fi
programme.desc: Quando suo fratello uccide accidentalmente un uomo, un poliziotto rigoroso si trova diviso tra la famiglia e il lavoro, e presto si trova su un percorso di collisione che cambierà le loro vite per sempre.

programme.title: Dolcezze dautunno
programme.desc: Maggie torna nel paese in cui è cresciuta per la lettura del testamento della zia Dee, morta sei mesi prima, e per partecipare all'annuale festival dedicato ai dolci d'autunno ideato proprio da Dee.

programme.title: Solo per lestate
programme.desc: Cercando di eludere gli sforzi delle loro nonne per organizzare matrimoni, due ex innamorati d'infanzia fingono di tornare insieme per l'estate.

programme.title: Inaspettate Passioni
programme.desc: Dopo una rottura, la giornalista Dana si ritrova da sola e bloccata in un ritiro yoga di coppia mentre la più grande storia della sua carriera si interrompe.

programme.title: The Bread, My Sweet
programme.desc: Quando Dominic progetta di sposare la figlia di Bella, due mondi si scontrano in questa toccante e romantica storia d'amore, sogni e biscotti.

programme.title: Ricomincio Da Te
programme.desc: La trentenne Daphe ha appena chiuso una relazione. A una festa incontra due uomini affascinanti e opposti: con entrambi avvia una relazione.

programme.title: La storia dell'amore
programme.desc: C'era una volta un ragazzo, Léo, che amava una ragazza, Alma. Le aveva promesso che l'avrebbe fatta ridere per tutta la vita, ma la guerra li ha separati. Da un paesino della Polonia negli anni Trenta alla New York dei giorni nostri ripercorriamo la straordinaria storia d'amore tra Léo, l'uomo che è sopravvissuto a tutto e Alma, la donna più amata del mondo. Oggi un'altra Alma, adolescente newyorchese e contagiata dallo stesso virus meraviglioso dell'amore, vuole essere la donna più amata del mondo. Sembra che niente leghi Léo alla giovane Alma ma… L'amore attraverserà il tempo e i continenti per unire i loro destini.

programme.title: XX secolo
programme.desc: Un fiammante impresario di Broadway che è caduto in difficoltà cerca di convincere la sua ex amante, ora una diva di Hollywood, a tornare e far risorgere la sua carriera fallimentare.

programme.title: A Royal Weekend
programme.desc: La storia della relazione d'amore tra il Presidente Roosevelt e sua cugina Margaret Stuckley che si consuma nel weekend del giugno 1939 quando il Re e la Regina d'Inghilterra fanno visita al Presidente presso il suo cottage di New York.

programme.title: The Farewell, Una Bugia Buona
programme.desc: Billi, nata in Cina e cresciuta negli USA, tornata a malincuore a Changchun, scopre che in famiglia tutti sanno che alla sua amata nonna restano solo poche settimane di vita, ma hanno deciso di tenere nascosta la verità alla diretta interessata.

programme.title: Criminali come noi
programme.desc: Un gruppo di uomini vuole raccogliere la quantità di denaro necessaria per acquistare alcuni silos e costituire una cooperativa agricola. Scoprono che sono stati truffati dal direttore della banca.

programme.title: Biuti Quin Olivia
programme.desc: Nei primi anni ottanta in una periferia di Roma cresce Olivia, una ragazza con un carattere difficile e ribelle rovinata da una situazione familiare difficile. La madre cameriera viene licenziata e il padre è un invalido civile violento e volgare. A scuola incontra una ragazza, Lili, con la quale litiga spesso. Quel che sembrava una rivalità ostile, diventerà invece una solida amicizia. Lili organizza a scuola un concorso chiamato appunto Biuti Quin Olivia alla quale partecipa volentieri anche Olivia.I genitori però non vogliono. Infine le due amiche cercheranno il vero padre di Olivia.

programme.title: Here Comes The Boom
programme.desc: Il professore di biologia Scott Voss conduce una vita ed un lavoro noioso, finché un suo collega Streb gli confida che aspetta un figlio. Ad una riunione dove il preside decide di diminuire il lavoro, decide anche di eliminare il corso di musica tenuto dal suo collega. Voss si propone di salvare il corso del collega cercando di recuperare 48.000 dollari. Dopo varie idee, a Voss viene l'idea di partecipare ad incontri di MMA, e nonostante le prime sconfitte, anche grazie ai suoi studenti riuscirà a vincere la sfida.

programme.title: Indovina Perché Ti Odio
programme.desc: Donny (Adam Sandler Jack e Jill), divenuto padre durante l'adolescenza, alleva da solo il figlio Todd (Andy Samberg Amici di letto) fino a quando, compiuti 18 anni, Todd decide di interrompere ogni rapporto con il padre. Ma, dopo anni di assenza, Donny inaspettatamente piomba in casa di Todd alla vigilia delle sue nozze con la bella Jamie (Leighton Meester The Roommate - Il terrore ti dorme accanto), e nel tentativo disperato di riallacciare i rapporti con il figlio è costretto ad affrontare le conseguenze dei suoi fallimenti paterni. Il film vede la partecipazione straordinaria del rapper Vanilla Ice, di Susan Sarandon (Thelma & Louise) e di James Caan (Agente Smart - Casino totale).

programme.title: La Dura Verità
programme.desc: Una produttrice televisiva romanticamente delusa viene coinvolta, suo malgrado, in una serie di stravaganti test dal conduttore sciovinista dello show “The Ugly Truth”, deciso a dimostrare la validità delle sue teorie sui rapporti amorosi e ad aiutarla a trovare l'anima gemella, ma con un risultato inaspettato.

programme.title: Tutte Pazze Per Charlie
programme.desc: A una festa, Chuck, dieci anni, non rispetta la regola del gioco della bottiglia, rifiutandosi di baciare una ragazza. Determinata a non far trovare a Chuck il vero amore, questa, per vendetta, gli getta il malocchio. Vent'anni dopo Chuck è un dentista che non riesce ad avere una relazione stabile.

programme.title: Scusi ma lei le paga le tasse
programme.desc: Un funzionario cade in disgrazia per colpa del nipote, che poi gli soffia la promozione.

programme.title: Gli altri racconti di Canterbury
programme.desc: Commedia sexy con barzellette ispirate a racconti di Aretino, Boccaccio e Sacchetti.

programme.title: Le inibizioni del dottor Gaudenzi vedovo col complesso della buonanima
programme.desc: Il dottor Gaudenzi, giura fedeltà eterna alla moglie morta, ma è perseguitato da incidenti con le donne

programme.title: Quando la coppia scoppia
programme.desc: Enrico, caricaturista trentenne, affronta il divorzio, la gelosia e trova una nuova compagna di vita

programme.title: Il lumacone
programme.desc: Gianni, cuoco solo e abbandonato, realizza il sogno di un ristorante in un vagone grazie a Ginetto.

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: Brutti Sporchi e cattivi
programme.desc: Commedia nera e grottesca in una baraccopoli romana: Nino Manfredi è Giacinto, patriarca pugliese che difende il suo denaro tra furti e scherzi familiari. Capolavoro di Ettore Scola, vincitore del premio miglior regia a Cannes.

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: Il club delle mamme single
programme.desc: Quando cinque mamme single in difficoltà mettono da parte le loro differenze per formare un gruppo di sostegno, trovano ispirazione e allegria nella loro nuova associazione e si aiutano a vicenda per superare gli imprevisti che ostacolano il loro cammino.

programme.title: The Dentist
programme.desc: La vita del dr. Feinstone, un dentista di Beverly Hills, sembra apparentemente perfetta, ma in realtà nasconde un terribile segreto. Impazzito dopo il tradimento della moglie, infligge raccapriccianti torture ai suoi ignari pazienti.

programme.title: Little Monsters
programme.desc: Lupita Nyong'o, Josh Gad e Alexander England sono protagonisti di questa commedia horror dedicata a tutte le insegnanti di scuola materna che motivano i bambini ad imparare, infondendo fiducia e proteggendoli dal diventare prede degli zombi.

programme.title: Nonno Scatenato
programme.desc: Alla morte della nonna, Jason e suo nonno Dick partono per il viaggio più selvaggio della loro vita. Tra feste, risse da bar e una serata epica di karaoke, le imminenti nozze di Jason saranno messe a rischio dall'irrefrenabilità del nonno.

programme.title: Irma Vep
programme.desc: Un' attrice cinematografica Cinese, in Francia per recitare in un remake di "Les Vampires", trova futili intrighi e vanitosi scontri sul set.

programme.title: Mamma mi sono persa il fratellino!
programme.desc: Quando i genitori partono per la Francia lasciandola col terribile fratellino, Kathy lo trasforma in un porcellino usando le pietre magiche della tata. La ragazza, però, finisce per pentirsene e fa di tutto per riuscire spezzare l'incantesimo.

programme.title: Finché giudice non ci separi
programme.desc: Massimo, Paolo, Roberto e Mauro sono quattro amici, tutti separati e accomunati dal rancore verso il giudice che ha seguito le loro separazioni. Situazioni paradossali e sorprese sempre dietro l'angolo, in una commedia divertentissima.

programme.title: Red Dog
programme.desc: Spedito nella fattoria di bestiame del nonno, situata nella remota regione di Pilbara, nell'Australia occidentale, l'undicenne Mick si prepara a una vita di noiosi stenti. Non si aspetta un cane che cambierà per sempre il corso della sua esistenza.

programme.title: El Zorro
programme.desc: ra intrighi e ingiustizie, il misterioso Zorro combatte contro l'oppressione difendendo il popolo con astuzia e abilità, tra duelli e azioni spettacolari.

programme.title: Zorro contro Maciste
programme.desc: Tra duelli e imprese eroiche, Zorro e Maciste uniscono le forze contro un potere tirannico, tra azione e colpi di scena. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi

programme.title: L'assedio di Siracusa
programme.desc: Tra assedi, strategie e passioni, Siracusa resiste all'avanzata romana in una sfida che decide il destino della città. Con Sylva Koscina.

programme.title: I leoni di Pietroburgo
programme.desc: Eldar Kan combatte in difesa degli oppressi, mettendo in difficoltà i nobili, tra cui due che non riescono a unire in matrimonio i rispettivi figli, così rapiscono la ragazza di Eldar Kan, Tamila. Liberata Tamila, Eldar Kan è sfidato a duello da Pavel, imprigiona Anastasia e viene imprigionato a sua volta dai cosacchi. Sarebbe condannato a morte, se Pavel non lo riconoscesse come nobile.

programme.title: La texana e i fratelli Penitenza
programme.desc: Dopo un'atroce violenza e la perdita del marito, Hannie Caulder giura vendetta. Assolda il cacciatore di taglie Thomas Price per imparare a sparare e inseguire i tre fratelli fuorilegge responsabili. Mentre si allena, i banditi continuano a seminare il terrore. La sua missione diventa un viaggio di trasformazione e giustizia.

programme.title: La morte sull'alta collina
programme.desc: Un'importante rapina va male, mentre due giovani uomini si ritrovano a ostacolare banditi messicani e malvagi uomini d'affari corrotti che vogliono indietro il loro bottino rubato.

programme.title: Due Magnum 38 per una città di carogne
programme.desc: Franco decide di uccidere il magnaccia della sua ragazza, e da lì le cose si mettono male e viene picchiato dagli scagnozzi che rapiscono e uccidono anche la sua ragazza. Così Franco compra due Magnum .38 da un tizio chiamato "Lo zingaro" e... è tempo di vendetta.

programme.title: Hellgate
programme.desc: Il grande inferno - Un uomo viene incastrato e mandato nella prigione più dura del territorio.

programme.title: È tornato Sabata... hai chiuso un'altra volta!
programme.desc: Il feroce pistolero Sabata protegge i deboli e caccia un sindaco corrotto che ha truffato un'intera città.

programme.title: Il mercenario
programme.desc: Un mercenario polacco e un minatore guidano una rivoluzione contro il governo oppressivo del Messico.

programme.title: Ehi amico…c'è Sabata, hai chiuso!
programme.desc: Un abile pistolero sfida i leader di Daugherty per rubare $100.000 destinati alla ferrovia.

programme.title: Non toccare la donna bianca
programme.desc: La battaglia di Custer e la disfatta di Little Big Horn sono ambientate nella fossa delle Halles a Parigi.

programme.title: I Maestri Del Cinema
programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi registi del XX secolo. Gli esordi, le difficoltà e infine i film e il cinema.

programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.desc: Il racconto dell'ascesa al successo del mito di Brigitte Bardot, incarnazione della sensualità femminile.
